text: Font Studio 是面向 DSH 网页客户端的字体与排版设置插件，在设置页加入字体工作室面板，通过 DSH theme 服务调整正文、代码和终端的字号与字体族，并以局部样式变量设置界面、会话和代码颜色。它还提供字重、斜体、行高、字间距、风格预设、实时预览和一键恢复默认。适合希望统一调整 DSH 阅读与代码显示效果的用户。无需 API 密钥或外部账号；颜色和风格保存在浏览器本地。

Font Studio adds a settings panel for DSH web users to tune body, code and terminal fonts. Set text sizes and families, interface and chat colours, weight, italics, line height and spacing; preview changes and reset them together. Colour and style preferences stay in browser storage.
想分别调大聊天正文、代码块和终端的字号。
能不能给代码和终端换成我常用的字体？
我想让聊天文字颜色更容易看清。
给我一个能预览不同排版风格的设置面板。
Can I change the font size separately for chat, code and the terminal?
I want to choose a different font family for code and terminal output.
How can I adjust chat text colour, weight or line spacing?
Font Studio 的功能「字号调整」：在设置面板分别增减正文、代码和终端字号，并限制在各自的有效范围内；更改写入 DSH theme 服务并同步预览。
Font Studio 的功能「字体族设置」：用户可为正文、代码和终端输入逗号分隔的字体列表，也可选用快捷字体；提交后写入主题服务并更新预览。
Font Studio 的功能「颜色与样式」：通过颜色选择器和文本框设置界面、会话及代码颜色，并调整字重、斜体、行高和字间距；无效颜色不会应用，预设可组合常用样式。
Font Studio 的功能「实时预览与重置」：预览区展示当前正文、代码和界面文字效果；点击恢复默认会重置所有字号、字体族、颜色与样式。
DSH 的聊天排版太挤了，怎么调行高和字间距？

dsh-font-studio README · Font Studio · 字体工作室：A DeepSeek Harness settings plugin for typography. It keeps the client's existing font controls — size and family for text, code and terminal — and adds text colour, weight, italic, letter spacing and line height, with a live preview.

DeepSeek Harness 的字体设置插件。保留客户端原有的字号与字体族（正文 / 代码 / 终端三档），并补上文字颜色、字重、斜体、字间距与行高，带实时预览。

dsh-font-studio README · What it adds · 功能：The page lives in **Settings → Font Studio** (left column, next to Appearance).

设置页位于**设置 → 字体工作室**（左栏，「外观」附近）。

dsh-font-studio README · What it adds · 功能：| Group | Items | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Size · 字号 | Body / Code / Terminal | Stepper. Ranges match the client's own clamp: 10–22 / 10–16 / 10–20 px |
| Family · 字体族 | Body / Code / Terminal | Comma-separated list; empty means the built-in stack. Quick-pick chips for common fonts |
| Colour · 字体颜色 | Interface / Conversation / Code | Colour picker + hex field + clear |
| Style · 字体风格 | 5 presets + weight, italic, line height, letter spacing | Presets: Default, Comfort, Compact, Soft, Emphasis |
| Preview · 预览 | Live sample | Renders Chinese + Latin, code, and interface text with the current settings |
dsh-font-studio README · What it adds · 功能：**Reset · 恢复默认** restores size, family, colour and style in one click.

dsh-font-studio README · Install · 安装：```sh
dsh plugin add https://github.com/GEMLZC/dsh-font-studio
```

The package declares `dsh.bundle` and ships a `cordis.patch.yml`, so no build step runs at install time — the bundle is plain JavaScript.

包内声明了 `dsh.bundle` 并提供 `cordis.patch.yml`，安装时不执行任何构建脚本——打包体就是纯 JavaScript。

dsh-font-studio README · How it works · 实现：- **Size and family** are written through the client theme service (`ctx.theme.setFontSize()` / `setFontFamily()`), the same Host-persisted preference the Appearance page writes. The two surfaces never disagree.
- **Colour** does not overwrite host styles. It re-declares `--dsw-alias-label-primary` (interface and conversation) and `--shiki-foreground` (code) inside a scoped selector: `:root[data-dsh-fs-*] body` for the interface, `[data-chat-flow-key]` for chat rows only.
- **Style** is applied through `data-dsh-fs-*` scope attributes plus `--dsh-fs-*` variables on chat rows. Unloading the plugin removes every attribute and variable it added.
- Colour and style persist in `localStorage['dsh-font-studio.v1']`; size and family are stored by the Host.

dsh-font-studio README · Verification · 验证：The repository ships the checks used during development:

```sh
node --check client.js   # syntax
node tools/check.mjs     # zh/en dictionary key parity + every key the components use
node tools/smoke.mjs     # stubbed React + ctx: apply → register → render → write → reset → dispose
```

dsh-font-studio README · Verification · 验证：`tools/check.mjs` verifies both dictionaries have the same 63 keys, that the 35 literal and 28 composed keys the component tree requests all exist, and that the stylesheet constant is well formed. `tools/smoke.mjs` drives the real component tree with a stub React and a stub Cordis context, then asserts that font writes reach the theme service, that out-of-range sizes clamp, that an invalid colour is refused rather than written, and that disposing the plugin leaves the document with no leftover attributes or variables.

dsh-font-studio README · Verification · 验证：`tools/asar-extract.mjs` and `tools/asar-scan.mjs` read packages inside an Electron `app.asar` from plain Node. They were used to confirm the host contracts this plugin depends on; they are development tools and are not part of the published `files` list.

dsh-font-studio README · Known limits · 已知限制：- The interface colour changes every element that reads the primary label token, so it affects the sidebar and settings too. Use **Conversation colour** to limit the change to chat records.
- Code colour changes the base foreground only; shiki syntax token colours keep the host palette so highlighting stays legible.
- The family field needs `theme.setFontFamily`. On a host that exposes only the read side, the plugin falls back to writing the `--dsh-font-family-<role>` body variable itself.
